command: cat /proc/mounts; for d in /scratch/mangocore-cpython-bench-suite /persist/pyperf/s; do echo DIR=$d; sha256sum $d/bench/bench_runner.py $d/bench/bm_float.py $d/bench/bm_string.py $d/bench/bm_nbody.py 2>&1; done
cd /scratch/mangocore-cpython-bench-suite && CPYTHON_ROOT=/tools/tests/cpython CPYTHON_BENCH_REQUIRE_SCRATCH=1 CPYTHON_BENCH_WARMUPS=0 CPYTHON_BENCH_RUNS=1 /bin/sh ./cpython_benchmark.sh bm_float
mount | grep -E '(/persist|/tools|/scratch)'; test -e /sys/kernel/stats/features && cat /sys/kernel/stats/features || echo PERF_DIAG_ABSENT
cd /persist/pyperf/s && CPYTHON_BENCH_WARMUPS=0 CPYTHON_BENCH_RUNS=1 CPYTHON_BENCH_TIMEOUT=900 CPYTHON_BENCH_WORK_BASE=/persist/pyperf/w /bin/sh ./cpython_benchmark.sh bm_nbody
cd /persist/pyperf/s && CPYTHON_BENCH_WARMUPS=0 CPYTHON_BENCH_RUNS=1 CPYTHON_BENCH_TIMEOUT=900 CPYTHON_BENCH_WORK_BASE=/persist/pyperf/w /bin/sh ./cpython_benchmark.sh bm_string
cd /persist/pyperf/s && CPYTHON_BENCH_WARMUPS=0 CPYTHON_BENCH_RUNS=1 CPYTHON_BENCH_TIMEOUT=900 CPYTHON_BENCH_WORK_BASE=/persist/pyperf/w /bin/sh ./cpython_benchmark.sh bm_float
cd /persist/pyperf/s && CPYTHON_BENCH_WARMUPS=0 CPYTHON_BENCH_RUNS=1 CPYTHON_BENCH_TIMEOUT=900 CPYTHON_BENCH_WORK_BASE=/persist/pyperf/w /bin/sh ./cpython_benchmark.sh bm_nbody
cd /persist/pyperf/s && CPYTHON_BENCH_WARMUPS=0 CPYTHON_BENCH_RUNS=1 CPYTHON_BENCH_TIMEOUT=900 CPYTHON_BENCH_WORK_BASE=/persist/pyperf/w /bin/sh ./cpython_benchmark.sh bm_string
cd /persist/pyperf/s && CPYTHON_BENCH_WARMUPS=0 CPYTHON_BENCH_RUNS=1 CPYTHON_BENCH_TIMEOUT=900 CPYTHON_BENCH_WORK_BASE=/persist/pyperf/w /bin/sh ./cpython_benchmark.sh bm_float

cd /persist/pyperf/s && CPYTHON_ROOT=/tools/tests/cpython CPYTHON_BENCH_WORK_BASE=/persist/pyperf/w CPYTHON_BENCH_WARMUPS=0 CPYTHON_BENCH_RUNS=1 CPYTHON_BENCH_TARGET_STATS=1 /bin/sh ./cpython_benchmark.sh bm_float
